prompts.series_analyst: Call series_analysis_brief() FIRST, then return ONLY the SeriesProfile JSON per your schema. No markdown, no explanation.
prompts.model_critic: Call model_critic_brief() FIRST, then return ONLY the pruning JSON per your schema (prune_models, reasoning, confidence). No markdown.
prompts.combination_architect: Call combination_architect_brief() FIRST, then return ONLY the regime JSON per your schema (regime, shrinkage_lambda, score_preset, reasoning, confidence). No markdown.
